_README: Edit the pools below to change SatRoverWatch wording without editing Python.
GRID_CHANGE supports {callsign}, {old_grid}, and {new_grid}. Keep those placeholders where you want the live values inserted.
The watcher avoids immediately repeating the last-used line in each pool.
If messages.json is missing or invalid, satroverwatch.py uses built-in fallback wording.
